def run_detector(phase):
    assert sha256(oracle_path.read_bytes()) == binding[oracle_rel]["sha256"]
    assert sha256(case_path.read_bytes()) == binding[case_rel]["sha256"]
    assert sha256(fixture_path.read_bytes()) == fixture_digest
    started = time.monotonic()
    result = {"phase": phase, "argv": list(argv), "source_sha256": sha256(source.read_bytes()), "oracle_sha256": sha256(oracle_path.read_bytes()), "case_sha256": sha256(case_path.read_bytes()), "fixture_sha256": fixture_digest, "memory_limit_bytes": 384 * 1024 * 1024, "wall_timeout_seconds": 15}
    try:
        child = subprocess.run(argv, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15, env=child_env, preexec_fn=child_limits, cwd=str(seat_root))
        result.update({"exit_code": child.returncode, "stdout": child.stdout, "stderr": child.stderr, "timeout": False})
        assert len(child.stdout.encode()) <= 32768 and len(child.stderr.encode()) <= 32768
        parsed = json.loads(child.stdout)
        ok, headline, checks, reason = oracle.evaluate_case(case_obj, parsed, child.returncode, child.stdout)
        result.update({"primary_pass": ok, "headline": headline, "supplementary": checks, "reason": reason, "overall_pass": bool(ok and all(check["status"] == "pass" for check in checks) and child.stderr == "")})
    except Exception as exc:
        result.update({"detector_error": type(exc).__name__, "overall_pass": False})
    result["elapsed_seconds"] = round(time.monotonic() - started, 6)
    return result
